Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the target URL in the first step. The problem specifically asks for the "latest 2022 Lego English Wikipedia article." The agent's initial web search query ("Lego Wikipedia article 2022") was too generic and returned the main disambiguation page (`https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lego`), which is not the specific article about the Lego company or brand (which is likely `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lego_(company)`). By using the wrong URL, all subsequent attempts to count images on that specific page (or its archived version) were based on a false premise, leading to the failure to find the correct data.
